_what: The CORE-ET LEC gate must recognise a real proof. `lhd lec` emits no top-level `verdict` field and its per-block diagnostic says "pass", so the gate read "pass", rejected it in strict mode, and its fixtures (written from the documented taxonomy) agreed with it.

mutants.name: L1 only a literal proven counts
L2 any defs line counts as proof
L3 strict ignores the proof test
mutants.old:
if [[ "$status" -ne 0 || "$proven" != "true" ]]; then
    echo "FATAL: LEC_STRICT=true requires a PROVEN result AND exit 0" >&2
